lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: CHAPTER IX. The Mock Turtle’s Story

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “You can’t think how glad I am to see you again, you dear old thing!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess, as she tucked her arm affectionately into Alice’s, and they walked off together.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice was very glad to find her in such a pleasant temper, and thought to herself that perhaps it was only the pepper that had made her so savage when they met in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “When I’m a Duchess,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she said to herself, (not in a very hopeful tone though),

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I won’t have any pepper in my kitchen at all. Soup does very well without—Maybe it’s always pepper that makes people hot-tempered,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she went on, very much pleased at having found out a new kind of rule,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “and vinegar that makes them sour—and camomile that makes them bitter—and—and barley-sugar and such things that make children sweet-tempered. I only wish people knew that: then they wouldn’t be so stingy about it, you know—”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She had quite forgotten the Duchess by this time, and was a little startled when she heard her voice close to her ear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “You’re thinking about something, my dear, and that makes you forget to talk. I can’t tell you just now what the moral of that is, but I shall remember it in a bit.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Perhaps it hasn’t one,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice ventured to remark.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Tut, tut, child!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Everything’s got a moral, if only you can find it.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And she squeezed herself up closer to Alice’s side as she spoke.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice did not much like keeping so close to her: first, because the Duchess was very ugly; and secondly, because she was exactly the right height to rest her chin upon Alice’s shoulder, and it was an uncomfortably sharp chin. However, she did not like to be rude, so she bore it as well as she could.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “The game’s going on rather better now,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she said, by way of keeping up the conversation a little.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “’Tis so,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “and the moral of that is—‘Oh, ’tis love, ’tis love, that makes the world go round!’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Somebody said,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice whispered,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “that it’s done by everybody minding their own business!”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Ah, well! It means much the same thing,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess, digging her sharp little chin into Alice’s shoulder as she added,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “and the moral of that is—‘Take care of the sense, and the sounds will take care of themselves.’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “How fond she is of finding morals in things!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice thought to herself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I dare say you’re wondering why I don’t put my arm round your waist,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Duchess said after a pause:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “the reason is, that I’m doubtful about the temper of your flamingo. Shall I try the experiment?”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “He might bite,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice cautiously replied, not feeling at all anxious to have the experiment tried.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Very true,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “flamingoes and mustard both bite. And the moral of that is—‘Birds of a feather flock together.’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Only mustard isn’t a bird,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice remarked.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Right, as usual,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “what a clear way you have of putting things!”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “It’s a mineral, I think,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Of course it is,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess, who seemed ready to agree to everything that Alice said;

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “there’s a large mustard-mine near here. And the moral of that is—‘The more there is of mine, the less there is of yours.’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Oh, I know!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: exclaimed Alice, who had not attended to this last remark,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “it’s a vegetable. It doesn’t look like one, but it is.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I quite agree with you,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess;

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “and the moral of that is—‘Be what you would seem to be’—or if you’d like it put more simply—‘Never imagine yourself not to be otherwise than what it might appear to others that what you were or might have been was not otherwise than what you had been would have appeared to them to be otherwise.’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I think I should understand that better,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice said very politely,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “if I had it written down: but I can’t quite follow it as you say it.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “That’s nothing to what I could say if I chose,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Duchess replied, in a pleased tone.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Pray don’t trouble yourself to say it any longer than that,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Oh, don’t talk about trouble!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I make you a present of everything I’ve said as yet.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “A cheap sort of present!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: thought Alice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I’m glad they don’t give birthday presents like that!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But she did not venture to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Thinking again?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Duchess asked, with another dig of her sharp little chin.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I’ve a right to think,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice sharply, for she was beginning to feel a little worried.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Just about as much right,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Duchess,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “as pigs have to fly; and the m—”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But here, to Alice’s great surprise, the Duchess’s voice died away, even in the middle of her favourite word ‘moral,’ and the arm that was linked into hers began to tremble. Alice looked up, and there stood the Queen in front of them, with her arms folded, frowning like a thunderstorm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “A fine day, your Majesty!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Duchess began in a low, weak voice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Now, I give you fair warning,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: shouted the Queen, stamping on the ground as she spoke;

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “either you or your head must be off, and that in about half no time! Take your choice!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Duchess took her choice, and was gone in a moment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Let’s go on with the game,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Queen said to Alice; and Alice was too much frightened to say a word, but slowly followed her back to the croquet-ground.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The other guests had taken advantage of the Queen’s absence, and were resting in the shade: however, the moment they saw her, they hurried back to the game, the Queen merely remarking that a moment’s delay would cost them their lives.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: All the time they were playing the Queen never left off quarrelling with the other players, and shouting “Off with his head!” or

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Off with her head!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Those whom she sentenced were taken into custody by the soldiers, who of course had to leave off being arches to do this, so that by the end of half an hour or so there were no arches left, and all the players, except the King, the Queen, and Alice, were in custody and under sentence of execution.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then the Queen left off, quite out of breath, and said to Alice,

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Have you seen the Mock Turtle yet?”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “No,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I don’t even know what a Mock Turtle is.”

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “It’s the thing Mock Turtle Soup is made from,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Queen.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I never saw one, or heard of one,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Come on, then,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Queen,

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “and he shall tell you his history.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: As they walked off together, Alice heard the King say in a low voice, to the company generally,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “You are all pardoned.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Come, that’s a good thing!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she said to herself, for she had felt quite unhappy at the number of executions the Queen had ordered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They very soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun. (If you don’t know what a Gryphon is, look at the picture.)

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Up, lazy thing!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Queen,

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “and take this young lady to see the Mock Turtle, and to hear his history. I must go back and see after some executions I have ordered;”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: and she walked off, leaving Alice alone with the Gryphon. Alice did not quite like the look of the creature, but on the whole she thought it would be quite as safe to stay with it as to go after that savage Queen: so she waited.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Gryphon sat up and rubbed its eyes: then it watched the Queen till she was out of sight: then it chuckled.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “What fun!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Gryphon, half to itself, half to Alice.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What is the fun?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Why, she,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Gryphon.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “It’s all her fancy, that: they never executes nobody, you know. Come on!”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Everybody says ‘come on!’ here,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: thought Alice, as she went slowly after it:

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I never was so ordered about in all my life, never!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They had not gone far before they saw the Mock Turtle in the distance, sitting sad and lonely on a little ledge of rock, and, as they came nearer, Alice could hear him sighing as if his heart would break. She pitied him deeply.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What is his sorrow?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she asked the Gryphon, and the Gryphon answered, very nearly in the same words as before,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “It’s all his fancy, that: he hasn’t got no sorrow, you know. Come on!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: So they went up to the Mock Turtle, who looked at them with large eyes full of tears, but said nothing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “This here young lady,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Gryphon,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “she wants for to know your history, she do.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I’ll tell it her,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle in a deep, hollow tone:

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “sit down, both of you, and don’t speak a word till I’ve finished.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: So they sat down, and nobody spoke for some minutes. Alice thought to herself,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I don’t see how he can ever finish, if he doesn’t begin.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But she waited patiently.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Once,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle at last, with a deep sigh,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “I was a real Turtle.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: These words were followed by a very long silence, broken only by an occasional exclamation of “Hjckrrh!” from the Gryphon, and the constant heavy sobbing of the Mock Turtle. Alice was very nearly getting up and saying,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Thank you, sir, for your interesting story,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: but she could not help thinking there must be more to come, so she sat still and said nothing.

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “When we were little,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Mock Turtle went on at last, more calmly, though still sobbing a little now and then,

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “we went to school in the sea. The master was an old Turtle—we used to call him Tortoise—”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Why did you call him Tortoise, if he wasn’t one?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice asked.

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “We called him Tortoise because he taught us,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle angrily:

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “really you are very dull!”

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “You ought to be ashamed of yourself for asking such a simple question,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: added the Gryphon; and then they both sat silent and looked at poor Alice, who felt ready to sink into the earth. At last the Gryphon said to the Mock Turtle,

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Drive on, old fellow! Don’t be all day about it!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: and he went on in these words:

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “Yes, we went to school in the sea, though you mayn’t believe it—”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I never said I didn’t!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: interrupted Alice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “You did,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Hold your tongue!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: added the Gryphon, before Alice could speak again. The Mock Turtle went on.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “We had the best of educations—in fact, we went to school every day—”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I’ve been to a day-school, too,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice;

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “you needn’t be so proud as all that.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “With extras?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: asked the Mock Turtle a little anxiously.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Yes,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice,

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “we learned French and music.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “And washing?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Certainly not!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice indignantly.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Ah! then yours wasn’t a really good school,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle in a tone of great relief.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: “Now at ours they had at the end of the bill, ‘French, music, and washing—extra.’”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “You couldn’t have wanted it much,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice;

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “living at the bottom of the sea.”

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “I couldn’t afford to learn it.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle with a sigh.

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “I only took the regular course.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What was that?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: inquired Alice.

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “Reeling and Writhing, of course, to begin with,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Mock Turtle replied;

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “and then the different branches of Arithmetic—Ambition, Distraction, Uglification, and Derision.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I never heard of ‘Uglification,’”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice ventured to say.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What is it?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Gryphon lifted up both its paws in surprise.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “What! Never heard of uglifying!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: it exclaimed.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “You know what to beautify is, I suppose?”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Yes,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice doubtfully:

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “it means—to—make—anything—prettier.”

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Well, then,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Gryphon went on,

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “if you don’t know what to uglify is, you are a simpleton.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice did not feel encouraged to ask any more questions about it, so she turned to the Mock Turtle, and said

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What else had you to learn?”

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “Well, there was Mystery,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Mock Turtle replied, counting off the subjects on his flappers,

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “—Mystery, ancient and modern, with Seaography: then Drawling—the Drawling-master was an old conger-eel, that used to come once a week: he taught us Drawling, Stretching, and Fainting in Coils.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What was that like?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice.

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “Well, I can’t show it you myself,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Mock Turtle said:

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “I’m too stiff. And the Gryphon never learnt it.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Hadn’t time,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Gryphon:

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “I went to the Classics master, though. He was an old crab, he was.”

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “I never went to him,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Mock Turtle said with a sigh:

lines.speaker: Mock Turtle
lines.text: “he taught Laughing and Grief, they used to say.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “So he did, so he did,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Gryphon, sighing in his turn; and both creatures hid their faces in their paws.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “And how many hours a day did you do lessons?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said Alice, in a hurry to change the subject.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Ten hours the first day,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle:

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “nine the next, and so on.”

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “What a curious plan!”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: exclaimed Alice.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “That’s the reason they’re called lessons,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Gryphon remarked:

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “because they lessen from day to day.”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: This was quite a new idea to Alice, and she thought it over a little before she made her next remark.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “Then the eleventh day must have been a holiday?”

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “Of course it was,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: said the Mock Turtle.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: “And how did you manage on the twelfth?”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alice went on eagerly.

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “That’s enough about lessons,”

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: the Gryphon interrupted in a very decided tone:

lines.speaker: Gryphon
lines.text: “tell her something about the games now.”
